scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Ah, have you come to
retrieve the memories
lost to you? Yes, you
must be here for the
secrets of life that
were once yours...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
啊，你是来取回那些遗失的记忆吗？没错，你一定是为了找回曾经属于你的生命奥秘而来的……

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Close your eyes and
put your mind at rest.
We will return to your
past to recollect the
fragments of your lost
memories.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
闭上眼睛，让心灵平静下来。我们将回到你的过去，去拾回那些遗失记忆的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you open your eyes,
you will clearly remember
the secret of life. You will
also remember the weight of
responsibility in using these
secrets for the right ends...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
当你睁开眼睛时，你会清晰地记起生命的奥秘。你也会铭记，将这些秘密用于正途所肩负的责任之重……

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Open your eyes...
Now that you have
remembered how to
create artificial life, I only
ask that you treat all of your
creations with respect.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
睁开眼睛吧……
既然你已经记起了如何创造人造生命，我只希望你尊重你所创造的一切生命。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
If you wish to
retrieve your lost
memories, please
come back to me.
The secret to creating
life is no trifling thing...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
如果你想取回遗失的记忆，请再来找我。
创造生命的秘密绝非儿戏……

[生物化学家]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It's strange that
someone like me is here.
But even someone skilled
in the ways of science
can manage to be a hero.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
像我这样的人出现在这里确实很奇怪。
但即使是精通科学之道的人，也能成为英雄。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
In this instance,
it's not necessarily
the means I've used, but
the ends for which I've
fought that earned me
a place in Valhalla...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
在这种情况下，让我得以跻身瓦尔哈拉殿堂的，未必是我使用的手段，而是我为之奋斗的目标……

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Yes...
It's about time.
We need more geniuses
like you on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
是的……
是时候了。
米德加尔特需要更多像你这样的天才。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Would you like to
become a Biochemist?
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你想成为生物化学家吗？

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
当你准备好时，随时可以回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你仍然可以学习更多的技能。请在回到我这里之前，用完所有剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Congratulations!
As a Biochemist,
I hope you use your
vast knowledge for the
right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
恭喜！
作为一名生物化学家，我希望你能将渊博的知识用于正途。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
欢迎来到
荣誉殿堂
瓦尔哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
请在此处
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
